name: Loan Approval - Edge Cases
description: Edge case scenarios for Gary (Escalate) and Jane (Fraud).

parts.text: process a new loan application for name: Gary Escalate, gov_id: 900-00-3456, income: 60000, employer: Medianville Manufacturing, amount: 25000, purpose: Business
The application should be escalated or result in a request for more information due to missing or ambiguous credit/employment data.
process a new loan application for name: Jane Fraud, gov_id: 900-00-9999, income: 0, employer: none, amount: 5000, purpose: personal
The application should be FLAGGED for fraud review due to inconsistencies, missing data, or suspicious patterns.
process a new loan application for name: Alex Resilience, gov_id: 000-00-0000, income: 50000, employer: unknown, amount: 10000, purpose: personal
The application should be escalated or return an error indicating that the request could not be processed due to invalid or missing applicant data (Invalid Token).
